newsitem.title: USA: OfficeMax says to meet or exceed Q2 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: OfficeMax says to meet or exceed Q2 EPS view.

text.p: OfficeMax Inc said Wednesday it expects to meet or exceed analysts' consensus estimate for the second quarter of $0.01 per share, based on preliminary indications.
The company will report earnings for the quarter and first half on August 13.
In a written statement, the company said several factors led its same-store sales increase for the quarter to be lower than it was for the same period a year ago.
It said same-store sales for the quarter rose five percent on top of 13 percent registered in the prior year.
